# PARADOX CAT

> PARADOX CAT builds Android Automotive HMI, real-time 3D graphics, digital twins and AI in-cabin sensing, plus the open-source 3D engine Ramses3D. Offices in Munich and Bucharest.

## Key pages
- [Solutions](https://paradox.cat/solutions/): services and products
- [Ramses3D](https://paradox.cat/solutions/products/ramses3d/): open-source 3D rendering engine for embedded systems, MPL-2.0
- [Case studies](https://paradox.cat/why-paradoxcat/case-studies/)
- [Numbers and approach](https://paradox.cat/why-paradoxcat/numbers-and-approach/)
- [Careers](https://paradox.cat/careers/)
- [Contact](https://paradox.cat/contact/)
